description:
Top Three Skills: 
 1. Sharepoint 2013
 2. Developer
 3. Self starter
 Job Description: 

 Someone who is extremely experienced with Dashboard and Sharepoint 2013. 
 There is already a sharepoint portal in place, we need a high level developer to go in and develop new enhancements and changes to the sharepoint app. 

 This candidate will need at least 5 years of experience.  

 we will review PowerPoint slides or a work portfolio.  

 This person can work remotely, however, the person selected for this role will need to work in Charleston, West Virginia for the first week or two.  

 Exclusive to TEKsystems
 It is a straight contract starting at 3 months.  

 Can work remote, and the manager will hire off of the phone. 

 Will have to be on-site for the first 2 weeks in West Virginia and then will sit remote. 

 
 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 3 Months
